description: State Highways and Subsidiary Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. LIST Transport Segment data is a subset of the LIST Transport Segment data and comprises transport routes with highway status. The subset has been created to provide clarity on ownership of roads (Authority). Metadata for each line is linked to the Transport Segment layer through the Feature Metadata Pointer (FMP) attribute. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are TRANSPORTATION, TRANSPORTATION Land. It offers 2 resource(s) in AUDIO/BASIC, HTML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
